commands.command:
mkdir release-artifact release-artifact/release
aws s3 cp "s3://${AWS_RELEASES_BUCKET}/releases/${RELEASE_SHA}/site.tar.gz" "release-artifact/<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz" --only-show-errors
aws s3 cp "s3://${AWS_RELEASES_BUCKET}/releases/${RELEASE_SHA}/site.tar.gz.sha256" "release-artifact/<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz.sha256" --only-show-errors

# Validate checksum file format strictly before verification
CHECKSUM_FILE="release-artifact/<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz.sha256"
EXPECTED_BASENAME="<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz"
EXPECTED_SIZE=$((64 + 2 + ${#EXPECTED_BASENAME} + 1))

ACTUAL_SIZE=$(wc -c < "$CHECKSUM_FILE")
if [ "$ACTUAL_SIZE" -ne "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
  echo "::error::Checksum file size is ${ACTUAL_SIZE} bytes, expected ${EXPECTED_SIZE}"
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$(tail -c 1 "$CHECKSUM_FILE" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' ')" != "0a" ]; then
  echo "::error::Checksum file must end with exactly one LF"
  exit 1
fi

if grep -qP '\r' "$CHECKSUM_FILE"; then
  echo "::error::Checksum file contains CRLF"
  exit 1
fi

HEADER=$(head -c $((64 + 2)) "$CHECKSUM_FILE")
if ! echo "$HEADER" | grep -qP '^[0-9a-f]{64}  $'; then
  echo "::error::Checksum digest or spaces are malformed"
  exit 1
fi

BASENAME=$(head -c $((EXPECTED_SIZE - 1)) "$CHECKSUM_FILE" | tail -c ${#EXPECTED_BASENAME})
if [ "$BASENAME" != "$EXPECTED_BASENAME" ]; then
  echo "::error::Checksum file basename does not match expected archive name"
  exit 1
fi

(cd release-artifact && shasum -a 256 -c "<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz.sha256" && tar -xzf "<site-project>-site-${RELEASE_SHA}.tar.gz" -C release)
commands.stderr: shasum: WARNING: 1 computed checksum did NOT match
